description: On 0.28.0, a titled HTML canvas in pane `journey` showed only the document title in its header, while the agent pane beside it showed its callsign. The callsign is how a person and the CLI name every pane, a canvas included, so the header should carry it beside the title. `PaneHeader.draw` sets the name label to `canvasTitle` alone when the pane shows a canvas (Sources/MusterMac/PaneHeader.swift, the `if let canvasTitle` branch); check its blame before changing it, in case the title was meant to replace the callsign. From tooling feedback a_33HBL2b22.
title: A canvas pane's header shows the document title and drops the pane's callsign
